description: This file defines a Migration class for version 3.3.3 of the OrangeHRM installer, responsible for executing SQL scripts during database migration.

classes.name: Migration
classes.description: A class representing a database migration for version 3.3.3, responsible for executing SQL scripts and returning the version number.

methods.name: up
methods.description: Executes SQL scripts 'dbscript-1.sql' and 'dbscript-2.sql' to perform database migration tasks.

methods.name: execQueries
methods.description: Reads a SQL script file, splits it into statements, and executes each statement against the database.
